Overview

Most Blockchain & Digital Trust for AgriFinance & Commodity Markets programs fail the same way: a pilot that impresses on a demo dataset and then dissolves when it meets farm management systems, exception handling and audit. We start from the production seams instead — the queues, the exception lanes, the reconciliation breaks — and engineer those first. What makes Agriculture & Food Systems different is not the math; it is the operating context: EU deforestation rules governs the data, yield per hectare governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
